records.text: The viewer handle Coco Rose contrasted available 2022 footage of Tyler Robinson’s minor accident with footage of his surrender reportedly deleted under a retention policy.
records.speaker: Handle Coco Rose (identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Candace (Candace Owens) is on leave party when they found out that Baron (Baron Coleman) would be taking over the show. Oh boy, yeah, it's only going to get worse. I'm sorry, Blake (Blake Neff), got to cancel the party. They were probably so excited, like, she's gone for like eight weeks. It's going to be so great. And we're of course going to attack her every second of the day, as we do whenever she's gone even for a week. Coco Rose (viewer handle as transcribed) wrote, and this is regarding the 2022 footage, a mystery. She wrote, so there was footage readily available of Tyler Robinson ... from several years ago in a minor accident, but the footage of him turning himself in was deleted due to their retention policy.
